summary: Africa's most established remote work visa. The Premium Visa is free, runs 12 months, and is renewable. No minimum income requirement is published.

program.name: Premium Visa
program.incomeNote: No minimum income published. Must show proof of employment or business activity based outside Mauritius and ability to support yourself.
program.applicationFeeNote: Free of charge as of research date. EDB published a fee update communique November 4, 2026 for some permit types. Verify before applying.
program.processingNote: Processing time not publicly stated. Apply online via the EDB portal.
program.workRestrictions: Cannot work for or with a Mauritius-based entity. Income and clients must be outside Mauritius.
program.verificationNote: Confirmed from mauritiusnow.com (Mauritius Tourism Authority) and edbmauritius.org (Economic Development Board of Mauritius).

keyFacts: Free application, no income minimum published
Must have travel and health insurance
requirements: Proof of remote employment or business outside Mauritius
whyItMatters: Mauritius offers the most accessible digital nomad pathway on the continent. No income floor, free application, and a renewable annual visa make it the top choice for remote workers wanting a base in Africa.
